# Exact versions of the base environment the tests were last run in (CPython 3.12, macOS arm64):
# the runtime dependencies and the "dev" extra together. pyproject.toml holds the supported ranges.
#
#     python -m pip install -r requirements-lock.txt
#     python -m pip install --no-deps -e .
#     python -m pytest
#
# The "dev" extra brings OpenCV and jsonschema, so in this environment the video tests and the
# schema tests run. The tests that need PyTorch are skipped; requirements-lock-train.txt is the
# same for the "train" extra. The check that the package and the browser runtime agree is
# skipped too, unless npm ci has been run in browser/; the browser workflow runs that check and
# requires it. The labeling tool under labeler/ needs none of this.
#
# Regenerate from a fresh environment with: python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
# and then: python -m pip freeze --exclude-editable. Each pin carries the SHA-256 of every file
# the package index has for that version, so pip checks what it downloads (and, with any hash
# present, asks for one on every line). To add them to fresh pins: uv pip compile PINS --no-deps
# --generate-hashes, keeping the names as written here. Dependabot updates them with the versions.
